race.comment: MR REIBY (5) dipped in his form last start at Hawkesbury after a good start to his career. Back to country grade today suits and he's well suited from the inside draw. Can bounce back to his best and he looks the main danger. COLORADO SUN (2) resumes today after showing good promise in his last campaign, jumping an odds-on favourite at Nowra two back. Will need a touch of luck from the barrier, but he can feature if he returns how he left off. I'M IRELAND (10) trialled nicely here coming in and won't be far away. PERCHANCE (11) showed enough in her debut campaign and kicks off over a trip that looks very suitable. Expecting a bold effort on resumption.
